Better than [[iron armor]]. Can be crafted or bought from [[Koukol]] for {{Money|2500}}.

Steel armor equips to the {{Icon|armor}} slot and provides 5 armor.  Each point of armor reduces damage by that amount, so a hit that would normally do {{Health|-|7}} in damage now would only do {{Health|-|2}}.  This makes armor incredibly useful against [[monsters]] who hit frequently but for small amounts of damage.

Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|150}}.
